tools.name: list_pools
tools.description: List THORChain liquidity pools with status, depths (1e8 base units), and USD asset price. Filter by pool status or by chain/asset to avoid pulling the full list.

tools.name: get_network_status
tools.description: Return current THORChain network parameters, including outbound fees, bond and reserve totals, and halt-related gas information. Pass `fields` to return only the keys you need.
